historical_contracts_and_outputs: A01, C02, and the prior capture are immutable forensic records; their historical results are not recomputed or relabeled.
release: No official corpus generation, calibration capture, or inference until C3 evidence review, completed worker, separate Bronze checkpoint, and explicit release.
stage1_estimand: Marginal RBF squared MMD between twin and variant distributions, conditional on admission, scored on independent source-pairs. For each group of n matched pairs, omit all matched i=j terms in k(x_i,y_j) as well as diagonals in the within-arm terms; divide each ordered off-diagonal sum by n(n-1). This is unbiased for the marginal MMD squared when distinct source-pairs are independent and identically distributed conditional on reference and admission; it is not necessarily nonnegative.
stage2_estimand: For the fixed-composition mixture use the realized admitted abnormal weight w=n_abnormal/(n_abnormal+n_ordinary), not the nominal requested burden: w² U(A,A)+(1-w)² U(O,O)+2w(1-w) mean K(A,O)-2w mean K(A,R)-2(1-w) mean K(O,R)+U(R,R). Independent iid draws are required within each nonzero component and the independent reference, conditional on admission and fixed reference bandwidth. Every nonzero component requires at least two observations; zero-weight components are omitted; otherwise abstain, with no biased singleton replacement. The independent control uses ordinary unequal-sample MMD U-statistic. Use all 220 distinct causal-reference rows for N=250; never tile. Record requested burden and realized weight separately and never redraw or rebalance. The statistic remains descriptive; no causal or business-scale inference follows.
bandwidth_independence: For each history, reserve 220 additional normal source seeds at pair indices [668,888), separate from scored [0,384), fixed original evaluation reference [384,604), exploratory null [604,668), and population [10000,...). Capture 220 bandwidth files per history with each of the three frozen encoders and compute each median pairwise-distance bandwidth solely from that pool. Thus fixed-kernel U-statistic unbiasedness is conditional on independent source draws within each component and reference and on the separately fixed bandwidth. The restored banks and all original 220 reference rows are preserved; no fitting of models or banks occurs. Additional bandwidth capture is 220*6*3=3960 successful forwards for a full six-history run, or 660 for one tiny history, with partial failed batches unknown. Capture reference once per history and reuse it for every Stage-2 arm; this avoids the historical 47520 redundant Stage-2 reference forwards. No official new pool capture is released before C3 gates.
synthetic_calendar: Use sprint24_controlled_data_execution.build_history_calendar, c1=0 and its 30-week/seven-month UTC projection. Reference end times preserve the approved 38.5-day, 220-slot prefix: c1-(220-slot)*38.5 days/220. Bandwidth slots use the midpoint after each reference slot; 64 exploratory null slots use the quarter-spacing after the corresponding first 64 reference slots. Actual generated twin length times the existing synth default dt=0.125 seconds determines planned source duration; reject a duration reaching one quarter of reference spacing. All pre-c1 metadata are planned synthetic times, not observed real timestamps. Each history/cell has a separate paired source scenario; indices 0..383 occupy weeks 1..10 in 40 slots/week after warmup. Each Stage-2 arm has separate mixture and control scenarios, placed in week 1 for weekly arms and complete month 2 for monthly arms, evenly spaced to requested size per scenario. Record scenario id, role, actual source identity and planned window/start/end; validate waveform lengths fit, no overlap within a scenario, and evaluation starts strictly after c1. Source pairs reused across family/severity scenarios are dependent, not new physical histories. These are parallel counterfactual scenarios in the same six history contexts, not 3444 operations packed into a single 40/week history and not a business-scale claim. Timing and labels remain metadata only, never model inputs.
confirmatory_source_disjoint_test: Owner-approved endpoint change: retain 48 paired K8 groups as descriptive diagnostics and test source-disjoint twin-only versus variant-only feature distributions within each history/cell. Generate the 384 planned pairs with frozen common eligibility: PAIRED is determined for every pair before arm assignment. Independently seed a permutation of the complete planned source index list with SHA-256 domain s24-c3-source-split-v1 and canonical history seed, family and severity; first half is twin-only and second half variant-only. Retain eligible files only, without redraw or rebalancing. The admitted source records must be independent and exchangeable conditional on frozen reference and common admission under the joint-three-encoder equality null; deterministic derived seeds alone do not prove that assumption. Every source contributes at most one file to the tested pool; all retained twin/variant embeddings remain available separately for paired diagnostics. Require at least two sources per arm or abstain with p=1 for multiplicity. At most 192 versus 192 sources before attrition. Use the mean across the three encoder-specific unbiased unequal-N Gaussian MMD² values, each with its corresponding causal-reference bandwidth. Permute whole three-encoder source records, preserving observed arm sizes, with 9999 independent Monte Carlo permutations from SHA-256 domain s24-c3-permutation-v1 and the same stratum identity. The directional statistic is larger for stronger between-distribution separation; p=(1+number of permuted statistics at least observed)/(9999+1), including ties. Fixed N=48 groups, no sequential look. Holm step-down at familywise alpha 0.05 across the complete 162 history-by-family-by-severity cells; abstentions contribute p=1, and a subset has no global-family claim. The test is conditional on common admission and tests equality of the joint feature distribution under exchangeability, not a response fraction of 0.5, no-effect equivalence, absence, business value, or generalization beyond the designed corpus. Stage 2 is descriptive.
seed_encoding_and_ties: SHA-256 UTF-8 bytes of domain|decimal-history-seed|family|severity-formatted-.9g; use the first eight digest bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer with numpy.default_rng. Compare permuted statistic >= observed minus 1e-12 (conservative tie tolerance). This namespace is independent of the generator source seed namespace; all splits include planned indices before admission filtering.
descriptive_fallback: Report scored-group estimates and response counts relative to the exploratory threshold, the realized admitted population contrasts and denominator identities. Clopper-Pearson intervals are conditional binomial-model descriptions, not established coverage for the shared calibration or dependent source process. No detection, equivalence, absence, business-scale or sequential-look conclusion follows.
calibration_status: The original four independent-normal K8 comparisons and interpolated q95 are exploratory diagnostic thresholds only; they do not establish the distribution of a common-source intervention null or a calibrated 5 percent error rate. The source-disjoint test instead uses its within-stratum permutation distribution, conditional on the stated exchangeability assumptions.
candidate_paired_swap_not_approved: Within-source label swaps require conditional pairwise joint exchangeability of injected and uninjected observations, stronger than equality of marginals; injection labels were not randomized. Global swap leaves the symmetric statistic unchanged. This is not authorized merely to obtain p-values.
multiplicity_and_fixed_n: The historical two-sided p=0.5 flags are not directional detection. No inferential multiplicity claim is made until a valid family of directional hypotheses and calibration is independently reviewed. Fixed N=48 groups is not a G24 sequential look. The six histories, three encoders, reused sources and shared calibration are dependent structures, not extra independent group counts.
retention: The capture retains per-encoder embeddings and file identities, source/pair/retry/disposition records, realized group/population memberships and fixed reference/calibration inputs. Each actual injection attempt emits a durable started event and an actual accepted/rejected/error event with attempt seed, common source/group, measured strength when available, and the gate/injector reason category; no discarded intermediate attempt is reconstructed after the fact. The generator retains existing RNG consumption and selection semantics. Raw waveforms are not retained; exact waveform reconstruction from seeds requires the same generator code, configuration and dependencies and has not been demonstrated. Embedding replay does not require waveforms or encoder calls. Partial forward counts remain explicitly unknown when an upstream feature batch fails before returning.
